sourceFile: 34. TIU C11-20 Report test  new Coil 2026.05.04. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable process evidence but changed-factor and measurement grouping are not reliable enough for final Ask AI evidence.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly merges two test coil types into one condition.
30% DCCA is treated as subgroup though evidence shows it is a primary test condition.
Model TIU C11-20R is mixed into condition naming instead of kept as context.
RAW measurement outcomes are noisy header-derived stats and not verified comparisons.
Some cited header rows are not shown in the review packet, limiting citation audit.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as coil type/spec: Normal vs 30% DCCA and Normal vs DCCA.
Keep TIU C11-20R, date, and test categories as subgroup/context keys.
Retain spot welding, open test, and function as outcomes under the coil comparison context.
Remove or separately verify RAW SPL/THD measurement tables before inclusion.
Use only cited rows that show both headers and condition/result rows for each outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Process result row citations are mostly sufficient; RAW measurement citations are insufficient for final evidence.
